That night, when he swept the bright beam across the water, he imagined a small boat turning toward shore, the past finally arriving.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的寂静里。高楼的窗灯稀稀落落，像未睡的眼。街道被雨水洗过，红绿灯照着空无一人的路口。便利店亮着暖黄的光，值班员靠在柜台旁打盹。远处传来首班清扫车的低响，混合江边隐约的汽笛。风带着潮气穿过楼宇，海棠花在街角静静开着。不久天边泛起灰白，第一辆公交车将唤醒城市。","w03":"- Think of a set of nesting dolls; opening one reveals a smaller doll under the same rule.\n- Keep opening smaller dolls until you reach one that cannot open, which gives the simplest answer.\n- Then pass that answer back through each larger doll until the first one receives the final result."}
